scope: VM UserData named binary payload transfer path
evidenceType: controlled runtime logs plus source decompilation
sourceBehavior: CGroupNode::LoadModuleData reads the serialized length, allocates owned storage only when length>0, and copies exactly that many bytes. The native getter path returns the stored length and copies into the caller buffer, returning E0000012 when capacity is insufficient.
implication: The empty Blob import values are a state of that specific Group export. The same VM binary-data path supports nonempty payloads, so local reconstruction must retain length and bytes independently of module scalar parameters.
unknowns: No captured log exposes the actual 647 or 2179 payload bytes.
The image-source payload format is not a Blob ROI/Mask payload and must not be reused as a Blob schema.
